bio.text: Greg Albritton, a Republican, has represented Alabama Senate District 22 since November 5, 2014; his current term ends November 4, 2026.
He ran for re-election and lost the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
He graduated from Ernest Ward High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Weber State University and a J.D. from Jones Law School.
His professional experience includes working in finance, working for the General Electric Credit Corporation and practicing law.
